Our story

A small range, honestly described.

We started Sarvha because finding a genuinely pure oil shouldn't require detective work.

The essential oil aisle is full of confident claims and very little detail. Bottles say "therapeutic grade" — a phrase with no legal meaning — and tell you nothing about where the plant grew, how it was extracted, or what else ended up in the bottle.

So we went the other way. We buy from a small number of growers and distillers we can name, we keep the range deliberately small, and we write down what we actually know about each oil: the botanical species, where it came from, how it was extracted, and what it smells like.

What we will and won't claim

Our oils are 100% pure and undiluted, with no synthetic fragrance or fillers. We ask our suppliers for the documentation that comes with each batch, and we'll share it if you ask.

What we won't do is dress that up as something bigger. We're a young business, and we're not going to overstate our testing programme or invent review counts. If you want to know exactly what we hold on a particular oil, ask us and we'll tell you straight.

On aromatherapy claims

We describe how our oils smell and how people like to use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine. If you're pregnant, nursing, on medication, or buying for a child, talk to a doctor first — and read our safety notes.
